hypotheses.H1: quote DML vs quote price-only: normalized total quote-risk RMSE
hypotheses.H2: quote DML vs theta quote-metric DML: paired normalized market-risk RMSE
hypotheses.H3: fixed-contract shock residual and entry cost
hypotheses.H4: teacher-inclusive surrogate cost vs exact and reduced regressions

metadata.normalized_risk_scale: common quote RMS within each training size

bootstrap.statistic: difference of square roots of mean group mean-squared normalized six-risk error

benchmark.selection_rule: Before main: five NN modes at largest N and seed11; price/differential ridge at largest N. All seed/N raw models remain separate.
benchmark.bump_reason: Rebootstrap 5 quote up/down plus center (11 calibrations) is measured for one predeclared S100/T1.5 contract only. Repeating identical scalar calibrations 1024 times is not a useful batch baseline; analytic/vectorized exact is the strong comparator.

loading.input_metadata_capture: Recorded after measurement; input bundle unchanged until this assembly.

costs.reference_policy: Exact baseline needs no additional fit; shared curve preparation/cache is compared in matched online operations.
costs.p95_policy: Sum of observed p95 operation costs is a separate cost scenario, not a measured p95 total or confidence interval.

experiment.teacher_accounting: Shared train/validation/test generation once; not the sum of each model's train teacher cost.
experiment.ridge_export_accounting: Included in elapsed_s; separate setup/training/export observations unavailable.

loading.assumption: Deployment includes loading the entire research bundle once plus decoding one model; this is not minimal standalone packaging.

fit.verification_method: Posthoc byte comparison with committed pre-fit source; financial digests were not captured automatically at fit start.

timing.verification_method: Posthoc digest of original measurement source retained while the same process ran, before validation edits. This original run did not automatically embed source digests.

loading.verification_method: Script embedded its source digest; archive identity verified before formatting.

validation.scope: Saved fits re-evaluated without retraining; measurement sources retained separately.
